crossRefs.note: “The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day…
The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”
“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master…
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
He said, “A certain man had two sons.
But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Son of Rechab, who promoted Rechabite lifestyle

people.name: Rechab
people.line: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God

translations.web: The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me.” ’
translations.bsb: Yes, the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them, but these people have not listened to Me.
translations.kjv: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them; but this people hath not hearkened
translations.asv: Forasmuch as the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people hath not hearkened unto me;
